Demonstration Alert: Update – U.S. Embassy Tirana, Albania – Thursday, October 15, 2026

Location: Tirana, Shkoder, Durres, Vlora, Korca, Kukes, and Elbasan, Albania

Date/Time:  Ongoing

Event:Demonstrations are taking place in Tirana, Shkoder, Durres, Vlora, Korca, Kukes, and Elbasan, especially in city centers and around government buildings.  Some demonstrations have turned violent.  Protesters have used incendiary devices, thrown rocks, and damaged public and private property.  More demonstrations may occur in the coming days.

Demonstrations may spread to nearby streets, bringing more police, traffic disruptions, detours, and road closures.  The U.S. Embassy in Tirana has told its personnel to avoid all demonstration areas.

Stay alert and put your personal safety first.  Monitor local media for the latest information and follow the instructions of local law enforcement authorities.

Anticipated Impacts:

Public Services – Expect additional closures or reduced services across Albania, including public transportation, government offices, and schools.

Actions to Take:

Strengthen your security posture by practicing the following habits:

  • Avoid demonstrations.
  • Be aware of your surroundings. Limit distractions such as phones or headphones in public.
  • Monitor local media.
  • Always have an emergency plan or exit strategy.
  • Keep a low profile.

Assistance:

Demonstration Alert: U.S. Embassy Tirana, Albania – Thursday, October 15, 2026

Location:  Tirana, Albania

Date/Time:  Ongoing

Event:  Demonstrations in Tirana starting on Durres Street near Skanderbeg Square and around government buildings in the area have become violent, including the use of incendiary devices, incidents of rock throwing, and vandalism of public and private property.  Additional demonstrations may occur in the coming days.

Demonstrations may also expand to nearby streets, potentially causing enhanced police presence, traffic disruptions, detours, and road closures.  Embassy Tirana personnel have been advised to avoid all demonstration areas.

Please remain alert and prioritize your personal safety.  Monitor local media and follow instructions of local law enforcement authorities for the latest information.

Actions to Take:  Strengthen your security posture by practicing the following habits:

  • Avoid demonstrations.
  • Be aware of your surroundings.  Limit distractions such as phones or headphones in public.
  • Monitor local media.
  • Always have an emergency plan or exit strategy.
  • Keep a low profile.

Demonstration Alert: U.S. Embassy Tirana, Albania – Wednesday, October 14, 2026

Location: Tirana, Durres Street next to Skanderbeg Square and nearby government buildings

Date/Time:  Wednesday, October 14, 2026

Event:  A protest on Durres Street next to Skanderbeg Square is currently ongoing and turned violent due to rock throwing.  The protest may expand to nearby blocks and government buildings, potentially causing enhanced police presence, traffic disruptions, detours, and road closures.  Embassy Tirana personnel have been advised to avoid demonstrations.

Please remain alert and prioritize your personal safety.  Monitor local media and follow instructions of local law enforcement authorities for the latest information.

Actions to Take:  Strengthen your security posture by practicing the following habits:

  • Avoid demonstrations.
  • Be aware of your surroundings. Limit distractions such as phones or headphones in public.
  • Monitor local media.
